basics.name: Zob Dhillon
basics.label: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: I build end-to-end web applications with Laravel on the backend and Vue, React, and Tailwind on the frontend. I enjoy turning ideas into real, deployed products — from database design to polished UI.

projects.name: Rehearse — AI Conversation Practice
projects.description: An AI-powered conversation practice app where users rehearse real-world scenarios — job interviews, salary negotiations, client calls — and receive scored feedback. Built with Laravel, Vue 3, Inertia.js, and the Groq API. Deployed on Railway.
highlights: Built a real-time AI conversation engine using Groq API with custom system prompts per scenario
Designed a scoring system that evaluates clarity, confidence, objective achievement, and adaptability
Implemented 20 practice scenarios across interviews, career, sales, and leadership categories
Deployed full-stack on Railway with MySQL, FrankenPHP, and automated migrations

projects.name: DevLogs — Developer Social Platform
projects.description: A developer-focused social platform for sharing posts, tracking learning progress, setting goals, and exploring resources. Built with Laravel, Blade, Alpine.js, and Tailwind CSS.
highlights: Built full authentication system with public user profiles and personalized dashboards
Implemented goal tracking, developer resources section, and topics/categories system
Integrated AI insights feature for developer content
Designed a dark-themed responsive UI with Alpine.js interactivity
